jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Junior Accountant – Comptabilité titres (80-100%)

Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités Global Assets+, nous recherchons un(e) Junior Accountant afin de renforcer son équipe dédiée au suivi comptable, administratif et fiscal de clients institutionnels, professionnels et privés.

Au sein d’une équipe spécialisée, vous participerez à la tenue de comptabilités titres complètes pour une clientèle variée, composée notamment de caisses de pension, fondations d’investissement, clients privés et trusts.

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle comptable lié aux portefeuilles de titres, depuis la saisie et le contrôle des opérations jusqu’à la valorisation, au bouclement et à la production des reportings périodiques.

Ce poste implique des interactions régulières avec les clients, les réviseurs ainsi qu’avec plusieurs départements internes de la Banque, notamment les équipes fiscales, opérationnelles et de reporting.

VOTRE MISSION :

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

• Assurer la tenue de la comptabilité des titres de A à Z pour différents types de clients

• Saisir, contrôler et réconcilier les transactions, positions, revenus, frais et mouvements de trésorerie

• Participer aux travaux de valorisation des portefeuilles et aux bouclements périodiques

• Contrôler la qualité, la cohérence et l’exhaustivité des données comptables et financières, notamment les prix de marché, classifications des titres, frais, revenus et informations fiscales

• Établir les rapports périodiques requis par les clients, les réviseurs ou les besoins internes

• Assurer le suivi administratif lié aux activités comptables et garantir une documentation rigoureuse

• Entretenir des contacts réguliers avec les réviseurs dans le cadre des audits et contrôles annuels

• Collaborer étroitement avec le département fiscal, notamment pour la récupération des impôts suisses et étrangers

• Participer à la production du reporting relatif au timbre fédéral pour les clients Global Assets+

• Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus, contrôles et outils de suivi comptable

• Participer, selon les besoins, à des projets d’optimisation opérationnelle, d’automatisation ou de digitalisation.

VOTRE PROFIL :

• CFC d’employé(e) de commerce, idéalement complété par une expérience dans le secteur bancaire, financier, comptable ou fiduciaire

• Formation complémentaire en comptabilité, finance ou gestion, un atout

• Expérience professionnelle de 4 à 5 ans minimum dans un environnement bancaire, fiduciaire, comptable ou financier

• Bonnes connaissances en comptabilité, idéalement appliquée aux portefeuilles de titres

• Connaissance des normes Swiss GAAP RPC, en particulier RPC 26, ainsi que des référentiels IFRS et/ou GAAP, un atout

• Intérêt marqué pour les marchés financiers, les instruments financiers et les opérations sur titres

• Connaissance du logiciel GP4, un atout

• Très bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques, en particulier Ex

Sie sind am gesamten Rechnungslegungszyklus im Zusammenhang mit Wertpapierportfolios beteiligt, von der Erfassung und Kontrolle der Vorgänge bis hin zur Bewertung, dem Abschluss und der Erstellung regelmäßiger Berichte. • die Führung der Wertpapierbuchhaltung von A bis Z für verschiedene Arten von Kunden sicherstellen,
• Transaktionen, Positionen, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Bargeldbewegungen erfassen, kontrollieren und abgleichen,
• an Portfoliobewertungsarbeiten und periodischen Abschlüssen teilnehmen,

• die administrative Überwachung sicherstellen Sie sind eng mit den Buchhaltungstätigkeiten verbunden und gewährleisten eine strenge Dokumentation.

• Kenntnisse der GP4-Software von Vorteil
• Sehr gute Beherrschung von IT-Tools, insbesondere Ex

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Internal Auditor (80-100%)

YOUR ROLE:

As an IT Internal Auditor, you will play a key role in assessing and enhancing the governance, security, and control environment of the organization’s information systems. Your key responsibilities will include:

• Conduct and support IT audit engagements focused on IT governance, application controls, and IT general controls (ITGC).

• Lead or contribute to reviews of IT security, IT governance frameworks, identity and access management, and IT project implementations.

• Contribute to business audit missions by providing a complementary IT perspective that enhances risk coverage and the relevance of audit insights.

• Develop and implement data analytics tools to enhance audit efficiency and effectiveness, including for risk assessment purposes.

• Prepare high-quality audit reports and present findings to senior management and relevant committees.

• Monitor the implementation of audit recommendations and follow up on remediation actions.

• Contribute to the development of the annual audit plan and support continuous improvement initiatives within the Internal Audit function.

• Contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

YOUR PROFILE:

To succeed in this role, you should bring the following qualifications and attributes:

• Master’s degree or engineering degree in Information Technology, Information Systems Management, or a related field.

• Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT, IS management, or IT security.

• Strong technical background, with solid understanding of multiple technology domains including Windows, UNIX/Linux, databases, networking, software development, and cloud architecture.

• Ability to translate technical risks into business-relevant insights for non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven analytical and problem-solving skills, with a critical mindset and attention to detail.

• Professional certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, or equivalent are highly valued.

• Familiarity with frameworks and standards such as ISO 27001, COBIT, NIST, and RISK IT.

• Good understanding of regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, Swiss Data Protection Law, FINMA circulars, etc.).

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English and French. Ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

• Naturally curious, self-driven, and able to work both independently and collaboratively.

• Willingness to travel occasionally for audit missions.

• Swiss domicile is mandatory.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Mai

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza professionale in IT, IS management, o sicurezza IT.
• Forte background tecnico, con solida comprensione di più domini tecnologici tra cui Windows, UNIX/Linux, database, networking, sviluppo software e architettura cloud.
• Capacità di tradurre rischi tecnici in insight rilevanti per le imprese per gli stakeholder non tecnici.
• Prove abilità analitiche e problem solving, con una mentalità critica e attenzione ai dettagli.
• Certificazioni professionali come CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC o equivalente sono altamente apprezzate.

Insieme, siamo un team unico, uniti nel servire i nostri clienti con dedizione inaspettata. Come datore di lavoro responsabile e di supporto, promuoviamo un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo per i nostri dipendenti e candidati. jobs.title: Security Master File Specialist (6-month contract)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Security Master File Specialist (6-month contract)

For our Operations department, we are looking for an agent to work in the Securities Files department on a 6-month fixed-term contract.
The Securities Files team is responsible for creating and monitoring new financial instruments in the Securities Database.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the opening of new financial instruments (funds, equities, swaps, yield curves, OTC, complex structured products, etc.)

• Creation of financial instrument values in the database (reflecting the attributes of official financial instruments) based on prospectuses, term sheets and official information received from issuers and various providers (Telekurs, Bloomberg, etc.)

• Work with traders and staff in the Operations department and external offices

• Research the characteristics of financial instruments on our Data Feed providers (Bloomberg, Telekurs, Reuters, Interactive Data)

• Carrying out various tasks relating to the maintenance of a securities database.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bac +2 in management/business/finance

• A first experience in banking will be highly considered

• Knowledge of usual financial instruments

• Knowledge of Bloomberg, Reuters, Interactive Data and SIX Telekurs will be highly considered

• Responsible, rigorous, autonomous and motivated individual who can adapt to different working environments. Strong sense of priorities and team spirit

• Ability to work under stress and absorb high volumes of work

• Fluency in French and English, any other language would be an asset.

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

• Bac +2 nella gestione/business/finanza
• Una prima esperienza nel settore bancario sarà altamente considerata

• Fluency in francese e inglese, qualsiasi altra lingua sarebbe un bene. Diversità, equità e inclusione sono intrecciati nel tessuto del DNA della nostra Maison, e ci sforziamo di garantire che i nostri dipendenti possano soddisfare sia le loro aspirazioni personali che professionali incoraggiando la mobilità interna e programmi di upskilling individuali. Crediamo fermamente che la costruzione di Diverse Teams contribuisca ai nostri successi e a fornire su questo, abbiamo attivamente incorporato Diversità, Equità e Inclusione nella nostra strategia aziendale. E' un momento emozionante per unirsi ai nostri team. Tutte le applicazioni saranno gestite nella massima fiducia.

Head of Identity and Access Management (80-100%)

Join Lombard Odier as Head of IAM and contribute to establishing robust identity and access management practices, protecting our critical assets and ensuring compliance with industry regulations.

YOUR ROLE

The Head of Identity & Access Management (IAM Manager) oversees all activities related to identity and access management to ensure the security, integrity, and compliance of information systems. They lead the IAM team (administrators, analysts), define the IAM vision and strategy, and ensure that the right users have the right access to the right systems at the right time.

The IAM Manager plays a key role in protecting the company’s information assets by ensuring alignment between business needs, security requirements, and regulatory obligations.

This role includes:

Leadership & Management:

• Define operational objectives, monitor performance, manage priorities, and ensure service quality.

• Oversee activities related to SLAs, security KPIs, and compliance indicators.

IAM Governance & Strategy:

• Define, maintain, and evolve the IAM strategy, including Identity Governance (IGA).

• Develop and enforce policies, standards, and procedures in line with regulatory frameworks.

• Implement and supervise controls, audits, and periodic access reviews.

IT / Business Collaboration & Integration:

• Co-design integrated solutions.

• Collaborate with HR, business teams, and management to facilitate onboarding, mobility, and offboarding processes.

• Raise awareness among employees on best practices.

Technology & Innovation:

• Drive the IAM technology roadmap: modernization, automation, integration of new tools, and workflow improvements.

• Maintain active monitoring of industry trends.

• Building, leading, and developing a team.

• Exploring new topics, learning, and deepening knowledge.

• Defining a vision and surrounding yourself with the right people to deliver it.

• Communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Designing and delivering value-added services.

• Working in a dynamic and complex environment.

• Taking calculated risks within your scope of responsibility.

• You have solid knowledge of IAM solutions (CyberArk, Okta, or similar).

• You are familiar with key IAM concepts (RBAC, Need-to-Know, Need-to-Do).

• Your experience includes participation in internal or external audits.

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients. Head of Identity and Access Management (80-100%) Join Lombard Odier as Head of IAM and contribute to establishing robust identity and access management practices, protecting our critical assets and ensuring compliance with industry regulations. YOUR ROLE The Head of Identity & Access Management (IAM Manager) oversees all activities related to identity and access management to ensure the security, integrity, and compliance of information systems. They lead the IAM team (administrators, analysts), define the IAM vision and strategy, and ensure that the right users have the right access to the right systems at the right time. The IAM Manager plays a key role in protecting the company’s information assets by ensuring alignment between business needs, security requirements, and regulatory obligations. This role includes: Leadership & Management:
• Define operational objectives, monitor performance, manage priorities, and ensure service quality.
• Oversee activities related to SLAs, security KPIs, and compliance indicators. IAM Governance & Strategy:
• Define, maintain, and evolve the IAM strategy, including Identity Governance (IGA).
• Develop and enforce policies, standards, and procedures in line with regulatory frameworks.
• Implement and supervise controls, audits, and periodic access reviews. IT / Business Collaboration & Integration:
• Co-design integrated solutions.
• Collaborate with HR, business teams, and management to facilitate onboarding, mobility, and offboarding processes.
• Raise awareness among employees on best practices. Technology & Innovation:
• Drive the IAM technology roadmap: modernization, automation, integration of new tools, and workflow improvements.
• Maintain active monitoring of industry trends. YOUR PROFILE You know how and enjoy:
• Building, leading, and developing a team.
• Exploring new topics, learning, and deepening knowledge.
• Defining a vision and surrounding yourself with the right people to deliver it.
• Communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Designing and delivering value-added services.
• Working in a dynamic and complex environment.
• Taking calculated risks within your scope of responsibility. Ideally:
• You have solid knowledge of IAM solutions (CyberArk, Okta, or similar).
• You are familiar with key IAM concepts (RBAC, Need-to-Know, Need-to-Do).
• Your experience includes participation in internal or external audits. NB: Please note that, in accordance with applicable laws and the role requirements, the selected candidate will be required to provide a criminal record extract (section 3). jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Identity & Access Management Administrator (80-100%)

Within the IT Operations department, you will join Lombard Odier’s Identity & Access Management (IAM) team, responsible for managing identities, access, and associated security for more than 3,000 employees.

In the context of a transformation toward Zero Trust, RBAC, and cloud/hybrid models (Entra ID / Azure AD), you will actively contribute to securing and automating the identity lifecycle.

YOUR ROLE

Identity & Access Management:

• Process and analyze access requests via ITSM tools (ServiceNow)

• Ensure access provisioning / deprovisioning and resolve IAM incidents

• Manage identities, accounts, and groups in Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)

• Administer access rights (NTFS, file shares, business applications)

• Monitor Joiners / Movers / Leavers (JML) processe

Automation & Continuous Improvement:

• Contribute to IAM process automation (workflows, scripting, APIs)

• Support the improvement of access models (RBAC / ABAC)

• Integrate new applications into the IAM ecosystem (SSO, provisioning, federation)

• Participate in the transition toward Zero Trust and identity-first architectures

Identity Governance & Security:

• Manage and improve access assignment workflows (IGA)

• Participate in access recertification campaigns

• Administer privileged access via a PAM solution (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust, etc.)

• Contribute to the management of sensitive access and secrets (Vault)

• Support compliance controls and audits (FINMA, ISO, etc.)

Support & Collaboration:

• Provide Level 2/3 support on IAM-related issues

• Collaborate with Security, Infrastructure, Application, and Risk teams

• Write and maintain technical procedures and IAM documentation

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong experience in IAM (Identity & Access Management)

• Excellent knowledge of Active Directory (on-prem) and Entra ID / Azure AD

• Good understanding of RBAC / ABAC concepts, SSO (SAML, OAuth2, OIDC), provisioning / SCIM

• Experience with an IAM / IGA tool (e.g., SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, ServiceNow IAM)

• Experience or exposure to PAM solutions

• Strong knowledge of Windows Server environments and access security

• Scripting / automation / GenAI knowledge (PowerShell, APIs, Copilot) is highly valued

• Experience in a banking or regulated environment

• Knowledge of Zero Trust / Identity Security models

• Familiarity with ServiceNow and monitoring tools (Splunk, Grafana, Elastic, SIEM)

• Experience in application integration (SSO / federation)

• Understanding of Cloud & Hybrid Identity challenges

• Attention to detail and strong security mindset

• Analytical skills and ability to solve complex problems

• Team player with excellent interpersonal skills

• Autonomous and proactive

• Ability to work in a demanding and evolving environment

• Fluent French and professional English required

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will

• Assurer en autonomie la gestion complète d’un poste de cuisine, de la mise en place à l’envoi.

• Préparer et réaliser les plats selon les recettes, les standards de qualité et les directives du chef de cuisine.

• Organiser la mise en place quotidienne : préparation des produits, anticipation des besoins, coordination avec l’équipe.

• Participer activement à l’envoi : dressage, rigueur et synchronisation avec les autres postes.

• Appliquer strictement les normes HACCP selon les procédures internes.

• Réceptionner et contrôler les marchandises, assurer un stockage conforme et une bonne rotation des produits.

• Contribuer à la gestion des stocks et remonter les besoins au chef de cuisine.

• Maintenir un haut niveau de propreté du poste et participer à l’entretien général de la cuisine.

• Accompagner les nouveaux collaborateurs, stagiaires et commis au quotidien.

VOTRE PROFIL :

• CFC de cuisinier ou diplôme équivalent.

• Minimum 5 ans d’expérience confirmée en tant que Chef de partie dans un restaurant gastronomique étoilé.

• Maîtrise solide des techniques culinaires et des standards gastronomiques.

• Excellente maîtrise des techniques culinaires et compréhension des standards de qualité élevés.

• Capacité avérée à tenir un poste en totale autonomie, avec rigueur et sens des responsabilités.

• Résistance au stress, ponctualité, organisation et esprit d’équipe.

• Excellente présentation et attitude professionnelle.

• Maintenir une qualité de service irréprochable en restant orienté solution et en démontrant un grand sens du service client.

• Proposer et mettre en œuvre des solutions d'amélioration des processus, tout en veillant à l'efficience de l'équipe.

• Rencontrer et communiquer de manière proactive avec les clients pour s'assurer de leur satisfaction et répondre à leurs besoins spécifiques.

• Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec les gérants et mandataires externes de nos clients.

• 3-5 années d'expérience dans le secteur de l'asset servicing, de préférence avec une clientèle institutionnelle et privée.

• GenAI-powered automated drafting of client communications

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. “Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship - Data Scientist

As part of the deployment of AI Copilot agents, we are looking to structure a monitoring framework to effectively manage their performance, quality, and adoption, while keeping associated costs under control.

YOUR ROLE

The intern will contribute to the definition and implementation of a monitoring framework covering:

• Response quality : defining metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination rate), and implementing (automated) evaluation mechanisms

• Performance and stability : monitoring response times, error rates, availability, and robustness of agents

• User adoption : tracking usage, analyzing user journeys, measuring satisfaction (feedback, NPS, reuse rate)

• Costs and FINOps : monitoring inference and usage costs, optimizing the value-to-cost ratio

Development environment and industrialization:

• Contributing to the structuring of a standardized Sandbox environment in collaboration with IT Infrastructure teams

• Implementing resource variability (Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, etc.) to facilitate production deployment

• Writing recommendations and best practices for integration, deployment, and industrialization of agents

Expected Deliverables

• A structured framework (metrics, dashboards, standards)

• Recommendations on architecture, processes, and development environment

• A first version of the monitoring solution (e.g., dashboards or automated reporting)

• Guidelines for setup, configuration, and resource variability

YOUR PROFILE

• Student in engineering school / Data Science

• Specialization in AI, LLMs, and production deployment challenges

• Comfortable with data analysis and technical environments

• Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and critical thinking

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship - Data Scientist

As part of the deployment of AI Copilot agents, we are looking to structure a monitoring framework to effectively manage their performance, quality, and adoption, while keeping associated costs under control.

YOUR ROLE

The intern will contribute to the definition and implementation of a monitoring framework covering:

• Response quality : defining metrics (accuracy, relevance, hallucination rate), and implementing (automated) evaluation mechanisms

• Performance and stability : monitoring response times, error rates, availability, and robustness of agents

• User adoption : tracking usage, analyzing user journeys, measuring satisfaction (feedback, NPS, reuse rate)

• Costs and FINOps : monitoring inference and usage costs, optimizing the value-to-cost ratio

Development environment and industrialization:

• Contributing to the structuring of a standardized Sandbox environment in collaboration with IT Infrastructure teams

• Implementing resource variability (Outlook, SharePoint, Teams, etc.) to facilitate production deployment

• Writing recommendations and best practices for integration, deployment, and industrialization of agents

Expected Deliverables

• A structured framework (metrics, dashboards, standards)

• Recommendations on architecture, processes, and development environment

• A first version of the monitoring solution (e.g., dashboards or automated reporting)

• Guidelines for setup, configuration, and resource variability

YOUR PROFILE

• Student in engineering school / Data Science

• Specialization in AI, LLMs, and production deployment challenges

• Comfortable with data analysis and technical environments

• Strong organizational skills, autonomy, and critical thinking

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

• Analysieren, kontrollieren und führen Sie verschiedene Arten eingehender Zahlungen aus, einschließlich eingehender Kundengelder, Überweisungen von Bank zu Bank und manuelle Eingaben, um Cashflows effektiv zu verwalten und genaue Finanzunterlagen zu führen.

• Traiter les frais de gestion avec précision et conformément aux lignes directrices établies pour garantir une facturation et des rapports financiers corrects.
• Gérer la diffusion et analyser les demandes des partenaires Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) pour les changements dans les relations avec les correspondants, garantissant une communication fluide et une efficacité opérationnelle.
• Mener des enquêtes et résoudre méticuleusement les rapprochements en attente liés aux paiements sortants, aux fonds entrants et aux frais correspondants pour garantir l'exactitude financière et résoudre rapidement les écarts.

• Maturité professionnelle issue d'une école de commerce ou d'un CFC
• Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans les opérations bancaires, plus spécifiquement dans les paiements (SWIFT, SIC, EUROSIC, SEPA)
• Capacité à maintenir une solide connaissance des messages SWIFT
• Travailler efficacement en équipe, être flexible et dynamique
• Démontrer d'excellentes compétences en communication et en respect
• Faire preuve d'une résistance au stress
• Avoir un bon temps compétences en gestion et en priorisation

• Mettre en œuvre des améliorations et des innovations (nouvelles idées ou méthodes pour exécuter certaines tâches)

jobs.title: Internship – Operations Support Specialist
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Internship – Operations Support Specialist

As a member of our Operations team in Luxembourg, you will discover various Middle Office / Operations activities and learn how much they are central and critical to our Maison, worldwide. You will be an all-rounder and work with our main Operations teams, such as:

• Security Master File: Opening and updating information in the Security Masterfile database on financial instruments held by our clients.

• Income: Payment of dividends, coupons and redemptions on behalf of our clients for all markets and all types of financial instruments, including structured products and derivatives

• Reconciliation: Reconcile cash, securities, listed derivatives, precious metals, etc. Comparing transactions and balances of the Bank’s books with our network of cash counterparties, securities depositories, Transfer Agents etc.

• Operational Taxes: Preparation of tax calculations and statements for Europe- based retail clients and enterprises.

YOUR ROLE

• Assist team members in daily tasks

• Work on specific project and requests, while learning from senior peers

YOUR PROFILE

• A keen interest in the Banking sector, especially in Middle Office / Operations domains

• Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently

• Motivated, detail-oriented, proactive, able to multi-task

• Fluent in French, basic English proficiency

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

It is an exciting time to join our Teams. All applications will be handled in the strictest confidence.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging (80-100%)

Lombard Odier group operates its own proprietary banking technology platform, used internally and offered to external financial institutions through a BPO business model. The Technology & Operations (T&O) department is responsible for maintaining and enhancing this platform by delivering robust and scalable solutions to support the Bank’s activities.

As part of the continuous evolution of our Operations Back-Office capabilities, we are looking to strengthen our team with an IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging.
The role covers a functional perimeter including interbank messaging, reconciliation processes, and client notifications (account statements, advices). It also provides the opportunity to develop expertise in SWIFT package integration, working at the intersection of business analysis and technical implementation.

We are open to SWIFT package integrators willing to expand their functional knowledge, as well as Business Analysts with a technical background eager to develop integration skills.
You will join the Interbank Messaging Team and work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders across Operations and IT.

YOUR ROLE

• Collect, analyze, and formalize business requirements related to interbank messaging (SWIFT), reconciliation, and client notifications.

• Act as the interface between business and IT teams, ensuring shared understanding of needs and constraints.

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and evolution of SWIFT-related solutions (FIN, MT/MX, interfaces).

• Participate in SWIFT package integration (configuration, testing, deployment).

• Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria with Product Owners and technical teams by translating business needs into technical requirements

• Ensure end-to-end consistency of messaging flows, including reconciliation and downstream impacts.

• Support incident resolution and root cause analysis.

• Drive continuous improvement of systems, data quality, and processes.

• Maintain documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor SWIFT standards evolution and market practices.

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related field (Master’s a plus).

• Experience as a Business Analyst / Technical BA / SWIFT Integrator in payments, securities, or interbank messaging environments.

• Good knowledge of SWIFT standards (MT/MX), reconciliation, and messaging flows.

• Solid understanding of data flows, system integration concepts (SQL, APIs, messaging, data models) and software development tools (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow)

• Strong communication skills in French & English.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and prioritization skills.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging (80-100%) Il gruppo Lombard Odier gestisce la propria piattaforma di tecnologia bancaria proprietaria, utilizzata internamente e offerta alle istituzioni finanziarie esterne attraverso un modello di business BPO. Il dipartimento Technology & Operations (T&O) è responsabile del mantenimento e del potenziamento di questa piattaforma, offrendo soluzioni robuste e scalabili per supportare le attività della Banca. Come parte della continua evoluzione delle nostre capacità di Operations Back-Office, stiamo cercando di rafforzare il nostro team con un analista IT Business – Interbank Messaging. Il ruolo riguarda un perimetro funzionale, tra cui messaggistica interbancaria, processi di riconciliazione e notifiche client (consulti, consigli). Fornisce inoltre l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze nell'integrazione dei pacchetti SWIFT, lavorando all'intersezione dell'analisi aziendale e dell'implementazione tecnica. Siamo aperti agli integratori di pacchetti SWIFT disposti ad espandere le loro conoscenze funzionali, così come gli analisti aziendali con un background tecnico desideroso di sviluppare competenze di integrazione. Ti unirai all'Interbank Messaging Team e lavorerai a stretto contatto con i Proprietari dei Prodotti, i Project Manager, gli sviluppatori e gli stakeholder aziendali in Operazioni e IT. Il tuo!
• Raccogliere, analizzare e formalizzare i requisiti aziendali relativi alla messaggistica interbanca (SWIFT), alla riconciliazione e alle notifiche dei clienti.
• Agire come interfaccia tra team aziendali e IT, assicurando la comprensione condivisa delle esigenze e dei vincoli.
• Contribuire alla progettazione, all'implementazione e all'evoluzione delle soluzioni relative a SWIFT (FIN, MT/MX, interfacce).
• Partecipare all'integrazione dei pacchetti SWIFT (configurazione, test, distribuzione).
• Definire le specifiche funzionali, le storie degli utenti e i criteri di accettazione con i proprietari dei prodotti e i team tecnici, traducendo le esigenze aziendali in requisiti tecnici
• Assicurare la coerenza end-to-end dei flussi di messaggistica, tra cui la riconciliazione e gli impatti a valle.
• Supporta la risoluzione degli incidenti e l'analisi delle cause.
• Miglioramento continuo di sistemi, qualità dei dati e processi.
• Mantenere la documentazione e la condivisione delle conoscenze.
• Monitorare l'evoluzione degli standard SWIFT e le pratiche di mercato. Il tuo progetto

As part of the continuous evolution of our Operations Back-Office capabilities, we are looking to strengthen our team with an IT Business Analyst – Interbank Messaging.
The role covers a functional perimeter including interbank messaging, reconciliation processes, and client notifications (account statements, advices). It also provides the opportunity to develop expertise in SWIFT package integration, working at the intersection of business analysis and technical implementation.

We are open to SWIFT package integrators willing to expand their functional knowledge, as well as Business Analysts with a technical background eager to develop integration skills.
You will join the Interbank Messaging Team and work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, developers, and business stakeholders across Operations and IT.

• Collect, analyze, and formalize business requirements related to interbank messaging (SWIFT), reconciliation, and client notifications.

• Act as the interface between business and IT teams, ensuring shared understanding of needs and constraints.

• Contribute to the design, implementation, and evolution of SWIFT-related solutions (FIN, MT/MX, interfaces).

• Participate in SWIFT package integration (configuration, testing, deployment).

• Define functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria with Product Owners and technical teams by translating business needs into technical requirements

• Ensure end-to-end consistency of messaging flows, including reconciliation and downstream impacts.

• Support incident resolution and root cause analysis.

• Drive continuous improvement of systems, data quality, and processes.

• Maintain documentation and knowledge sharing.

• Monitor SWIFT standards evolution and market practices.

• Good knowledge of SWIFT standards (MT/MX), reconciliation, and messaging flows.

• Solid understanding of data flows, system integration concepts (SQL, APIs, messaging, data models) and software development tools (Jira, Confluence, ServiceNow)

• Strong communication skills in French & English.

• Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and prioritization skills.

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

• Analyse and take in charge cost corrections.

• Create deposit securities entry into the client account.

• Communicate and exchange SSI and matching details with counterparties.

• Place instructions on the market (Swift) as per market practice rules and market guide

• Good knowledge of SWIFT messages

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Senior IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform (renewal of our platforms), we are looking for production engineers familiar with technologies around file transfer, scheduling and alerting, who will be able to support us throughout this transformation, while at the same time supporting the current installed base.

Management of an application pool within the IT Operations department (Technologies and Operations unit), in a team of 7 employees operating from Geneva.

YOUR MISSION

• Responsible for implementing business requests on our alerting/scheduling/file transfer platforms

• Qualification of requests, detailed documentation of specs

• Actively participate and make proposals for the evolution of the platforms

• Actively participate and make proposals to improve and automate existing processes

• Level 2/3 support for existing workflows

Internal Contacts:

• Steering committee

• Production team (Product-Support)

• Integration team

• All technical teams (Data bases, System, Telecom, Citrix,)

• Development teams based in Geneva

• Support teams (Service Desk and Application Support)

• Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

External Contacts:

• Suppliers of external products and/or services

• Technical sponsors of certain banking infrastructure customers

• Technical sponsors of partners of our banking infrastructure customers

YOUR PROFILE

• Higher education in computer science (Master's degree or equivalent)

• 2 to 10 years in a similar position

• Significant experience on file transfer: implementation of industrial transfer protocols, certificate management. GoAnywhere would be a plus

• Scheduling: OpCon, Control-M or equivalent would be a plus

• Monitoring/alerting: Service Now Event Management, Nagios, SCOM, scripting (Powershell, shell) would be a plus

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, flexible and with good interpersonal skills. Strong team spirit, desire for continuous improvement, proactive.

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willing to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe that building Diverse Teams contributes to our successes and to deliver on this, we actively embed Diversity, Equity and Inclusion in our business strategy.

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Production Engineer – Scheduling / File Transfer / Monitoring (80-100%)

As part of the modernization of our IT platform and the adoption of new technologies, we are looking for a junior production engineer eager to learn and grow in areas such as Cloud, DevOps, and AI-driven automation. You will join a dynamic team of 7 engineers within the IT Operations department and contribute to the evolution of our production environment. The team is responsible for Scheduling, File Transfer and Monitoring inside IT Delivery Team

YOUR ROLE

• Operate and monitor production systems in a hybrid environment (on-premise and Cloud).

• Implement and automate workflows using DevOps practices (CI/CD pipelines, scripting).

• Participate in Cloud migration projects and help define best practices.

• Contribute to AI-based initiatives for predictive monitoring and process optimization.

• Provide Level 2/3 support for production incidents and collaborate with technical teams.

• Document processes and propose improvements for reliability and efficiency.

• Internal Contacts: Production team (Product-Support, Exploitation), Integration team, Infrastructure teams (Databases, Systems, Networks), Development teams, Service Management teams (Incidents and Problems)

• External Contacts: Cloud service providers, Technology partners, and vendors

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science or equivalent.

• Zero to 3-4 years of experience in a similar role

• Knowledge of Cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

• Knowledge of DevOps tools (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI, Docker, Kubernetes).

• Knowledge of scripting (Python, Bash) and interest in automation.

• Curiosity about AI technologies and their application in IT operations.

• Good analytical skills, willingness to learn, and team spirit.

• Fluent in French and English (spoken and written).

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

• Cloud: Azure

• DevOps: Git, AzureDevOps CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes

• Automation & Scripting: Opcon, GoAnyhere, Python, Bash, PowerShell

• Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, ServiceNow Event Management

• AI & Analytics: APIs for predictive monitoring, anomaly detection tools

• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, Ansible

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. Coaching, Mentoring & Enablement

• Experience in Agile and DevOps environments

• Hands-on with frameworks: Cucumber, Gatling, Karate, JMeter, Playwright or similar

• Experience with tools: Tosca, qTest, XRay or similar

• Development experience in Java (Spring/Quarkus) and/or JS/TS

• Experience with CI/CD integration and cloud-native environments

• Exposure to functional, API, performance, and smoke testing

• Ability to influence, coach, and inspire

• Strong communication and adaptability

• Empathy and passion for enabling others

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset

• Collaborative and comfortable in multicultural environments

• Fluent in English and French

• Based in Switzerland or willing to relocate

A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Human Resources Business Partner – Technology & Operations & Central Functions (80-100%)

Lombard Odier is looking for an HR Business Partner to support its Technology & Operations & Central Function teams based in Switzerland. As a strategic HR business partner, you are the primary HR Partner for your Business Unit. You co-design HR strategy, anticipate organizational transformations and drive change in direct alignment with Business strategy.

YOUR ROLE

Strategic Partnership

• Develop a deep understanding of the BU’s business priorities

• Advise and challenge senior managers and leadership on organizational decisions, talent strategy, and performance

• Actively contribute to leadership committees and discussions on the evolution of the operating model

• Handle sensitive employee relations cases (harassment, misconduct, grievances, dismissal)

• Be a key point of contact for all employees to offer advice on career development, performance management, resolving conflicts

Change Management

• Identify and anticipate the human impact of transformations (restructuring, cultural shifts, digitalization)

• Design and lead change management plans: communication, capability building, and stakeholder engagement

• Ensure employee buy-in and sustained engagement throughout transition phases

• Measure change effectiveness and continuously adjust approach based on feedback and data

• Organizational Development & Talent

Lead talent review with the Business Unit

• Coach and support managers in strengthening their leadership capabilities

• Identify capability gaps and co-build tailored development plans

• Work closely with our Learning & Development team to identify training/coaching needs for business units

HR Operational Excellence

• Ensure quality and consistency of HR processes within the BU (Talent review, performance review & Objectif setting, yearly compensation review)

• Maintain social compliance and a healthy work environment (labor relations, psychosocial risk prevention)

• Leverage HR data and analytics to produce actionable insights for the business

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven experience (3+ years) as an HR Business Partner in a demanding environment

• Ability to read business environment and think in terms of organizational impact

• Advisory posture: assertiveness, courage and willingness to challenge status quo

• Strong facilitation, influencing and communication skills across all levels

• Results-oriented with a strong sense of priorities

• Comfortable with ambiguity

• Fluency in French and English (spoken and written)

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate.

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Stagiaire - Database Administration & Observability Specialist (Foglight / Elastic)

Dans le cadre du renforcement de la supervision des bases de données et du déploiement d’une plateforme d’observabilité centralisée, l’équipe DBA recherche un(e) stagiaire pour accompagner un projet stratégique autour de Foglight (monitoring bases de données) et de son intégration avec la plateforme Elastic utilisée à l’échelle de la banque.

Ce stage offre une exposition concrète à des environnements bancaires critiques , des technologies de supervision modernes et à un projet transverse impliquant plusieurs équipes IT (DBA, Systèmes, Sécurité, Observabilité).

Le/la stagiaire accompagnera l’équipe DBA dans le suivi, la coordination, le déploiement et la documentation du projet Foglight, ainsi que dans son intégration avec la plateforme d’observabilité Elastic .

Le stage combine :

• Pilotage fonctionnel de projet,

• Mise en œuvre technique encadrée,

• Communication et documentation,

• Découverte des bonnes pratiques de supervision en milieu bancaire.

VOTRE MISSION

1. Pilotage et coordination du projet Foglight

• Participer au suivi du planning global Foglight & Elastic .

• Organiser et coordonner les réunions avec :

• Les référents des différentes technologies DB au sein de l’équipe DBA,

• Les équipes Systèmes, Sécurité et Observabilité.

• Préparer les comptes-rendus , tableaux de suivi et reportings d’avancement.

• Contribuer à la circulation fluide de l’information entre les équipes.

2. Implémentation de la supervision Foglight

Accompagné(e) par les experts DBA, le/la stagiaire participera à :

• L’ajout des environnements Test / UAT / Production dans Foglight.

• La validation des métriques collectées pour les différents SGBD.

• La création de dashboards de santé haut niveau par technologie.

• La définition et le paramétrage des alertes pertinentes .

• L’intégration avec ServiceNow pour l’ouverture automatique d’incidents.

• L’intégration avec Elastic pour la remontée des métriques de supervision.

3. Documentation et structuration

• Rédiger et maintenir la documentation projet .

• Produire la documentation fonctionnelle de l’intégration Foglight → Elastic .

• Créer des guides utilisateurs et procédures internes destinés aux équipes IT.

4. Support à la formation interne

• Préparer des supports de formation (présentations, guides).

• Contribuer à l’organisation et au bon déroulement de sessions de formation internes sur Foglight et Elastic.

5. Communication et visibilité du projet

• Préparer les communications internes officielles liées au projet.

• Mettre à jour les espaces Confluence / Teams .

• Participer à la communication autour des sujets d’ observabilité au sein de la banque.

Missions spécifiques – Observabilité Elastic

• Recueillir et formaliser les besoins en métriques, alertes et dashboards Elastic.

• Décrire fonctionnellement les flux de données Foglight → Elastic .

• Coordonner les échanges entre l’équipe DBA et l’équipe O

• Integrazione con Elastico per il sollevamento delle metriche di monitoraggio. 3. Documentazione e strutturazione
• Scrivere e mantenere la documentazione del progetto.
• Produrre documentazione funzionale di Foglight → Integrazione elastica.
• Crea guide utente e procedure interne per i team IT. 4. Supporto per la formazione interna
• Preparare materiali di formazione (presentazioni, guide).
• Contribuire all'organizzazione e al regolare funzionamento delle sessioni di formazione interna su Foglight e Elastic. 5. Comunicazione e visibilità del progetto
• Preparare comunicazioni interne formali relative al progetto.
• Aggiornamento Confluenza / Spazi di squadra.
• Partecipare alla comunicazione su soggetti di osservabilità all'interno della banca. Missioni specifiche – Osservabilità elastica
• Raccogliere e formalizzare i requisiti di Elastic metric, alert e dashboard.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Eine Karriere bei Lombard Odier bedeutet, für einen renommierten globalen Vermögensverwalter mit einem starken Fokus auf nachhaltiges Investieren zu arbeiten. Als innovative Bank der Wahl für private und institutionelle Kunden ist unser unabhängiges Unternehmen eine der bestkapitalisierten Bankengruppen der Welt, verwaltet fast 300 Milliarden CHF und ist in über 25 Niederlassungen auf vier Kontinenten tätig. Mit einer über 230-jährigen Geschichte ist Lombard Odier ein Investmenthaus, das ein umfassendes Angebot an diskretionärer und beratender Portfolioverwaltung, Vermögensdienstleistungen und Verwahrung anbietet. Darüber hinaus bieten wir über Lombard Odier Investment Managers Vermögensverwaltungsdienstleistungen und Anlagestrategien an und stellen anderen Finanzinstituten fortschrittliche Banktechnologie zur Verfügung. „Alles neu denken“ ist unsere Philosophie – sie steht im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Wir sind durch mehr als 40 Finanzkrisen stärker geworden, indem wir die Welt um uns herum neu überdacht haben, um unseren Kunden eine neue Investitionsperspektive zu bieten. Praktikant – Datenbankverwaltungs- und Observability-Spezialist (Foglight/Elastic) Im Rahmen der Stärkung der Datenbanküberwachung und der Bereitstellung einer zentralisierten Observability-Plattform sucht das DBA-Team einen Praktikanten, der ein strategisches Projekt rund um Foglight (Überwachung von Datenbanken) und dessen Integration mit der in der gesamten Bank verwendeten Elastic-Plattform unterstützt. Dieses Praktikum bietet einen konkreten Einblick in kritische Bankumgebungen, moderne Überwachungstechnologien und ein funktionsübergreifendes Projekt, an dem mehrere IT-Teams beteiligt sind (DBA, Systeme, Sicherheit, Observability). Der Praktikant unterstützt das DBA-Team bei der Überwachung, Koordination, Bereitstellung und Dokumentation des Foglight-Projekts sowie bei seiner Integration mit der Elastic Observability-Plattform. Das Praktikum kombiniert:
• Funktionales Projektmanagement,
• Beaufsichtigte technische Umsetzung,
• Kommunikation und Dokumentation,
• Entdeckung guter Aufsichtspraktiken im Bankenumfeld. IHRE AUFGABE 1. Management und Koordination des Foglight-Projekts
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Überwachung der gesamten Foglight- und Elastic-Planung.
• Organisieren und koordinieren Sie Besprechungen mit:
• Den Vertretern der verschiedenen DB-Technologien innerhalb des DBA-Teams,
• Den System-, Sicherheits- und Observability-Teams.
• Erstellen Sie Berichte, Überwachungstabellen und Fortschrittsberichte.
• Tragen Sie zum reibungslosen Informationsfluss zwischen den Teams bei. 2. Implementierung der Foglight-Überwachung. Begleitet von DBA-Experten wird der Praktikant an Folgendem teilnehmen:
• Der Hinzufügung von Test-/UAT-/Produktionsumgebungen in Foglight.
• Validierung der für die verschiedenen DBMS gesammelten Metriken.
• Die Erstellung von Gesundheits-Dashboards auf hoher Ebene mithilfe von Technologie.
• Definition und Konfiguration relevanter Alarme.
• Integration mit ServiceNow zum automatischen Öffnen von Vorfällen.
• Integration mit Elastic für die Berichterstellung von Überwachungsmetriken. 3. Dokumentation und Strukturierung
• Projektdokumentation erstellen und pflegen.
• Erstellen Sie eine funktionale Dokumentation für die Foglight → Elastic-Integration.
• Erstellen Sie Benutzerhandbücher und interne Verfahren für IT-Teams. 4. Interne Schulungsunterstützung
• Bereiten Sie Schulungsmaterialien vor (Präsentationen, Leitfäden).
• Tragen Sie zur Organisation und zum reibungslosen Ablauf interner Schulungssitzungen zu Foglight und Elastic bei. 5. Projektkommunikation und Sichtbarkeit
• Bereiten Sie offizielle interne Kommunikationen im Zusammenhang mit dem Projekt vor.
• Aktualisieren Sie Confluence/Teams-Bereiche.
• Beteiligen Sie sich an der Kommunikation zu Observability-Fragen innerhalb der Bank. Spezifische Missionen – Elastic Observability
• Erfassen und formalisieren Sie den Bedarf an Elastic-Metriken, -Warnungen und -Dashboards.
• Funktionale Beschreibung von Foglight → elastischen Datenflüssen.
• Koordinieren Sie den Austausch zwischen dem DBA-Team und dem O-Team

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

descriptionByLocale.en:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Business Risk Manager - Technology & Operations (80-100%)

As part of the Technology & Operations (T&O) Business Risk Management team, you will partner with stakeholders across Operations and Technology to identify key risks, coordinate remediation, and strengthen first‑line ownership of controls. You will contribute to the effective oversight of operational, technology and information risks, and ensure transparent and timely reporting to management.

YOUR ROLE

Risk Identification, Assessment & Reporting

• Identify, assess, and report operational risks, including processing, trade order execution, operational taxes, technology, cybersecurity, and information‑related risks across T&O.

• Support the RCSA process and ensure risk assessments remain current, well‑documented, and evidence‑based.

• Manage the T&O incident process, ensuring incidents are recorded, analysed, escalated, and followed through to closure.

Control Environment Oversight

• Contribute to the T&O Risk Assurance Plan through thematic reviews, independent design and operating effectiveness testing of the control environment, and follow‑up of identified gaps.

• Support the ISAE control framework, ensuring required evidence is collected, complete, and audit‑ready.

Remediation & Issue Management

• Drive, coordinate, and track risk remediation activities, ensuring actions are well defined, owned, and delivered on time.

• Monitor and report on the progression of identified issues, ensuring consistent closure, documentation, and controls uplift.

Governance, Assurance & Culture

• Promote a strong risk culture by supporting awareness, training, and constructive challenge across teams.

• Prepare structured and insightful risk reports to the T&O Risk Committee and senior management.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 5 years' experience in risk management, internal control, audit, or consulting (e.g., Big Four) with focus on operational or technology‑related risks.

• Solid understanding of operations, IT, cybersecurity, and information risk, ideally within financial services.

• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, detail‑oriented approach.

• Excellent communication skills in English and French, with the ability to challenge stakeholders constructively.

• Resident in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We firmly believe

jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%)

Within our IT Department, you will join a team of experts responsible for the evolution of our financial ecosystem. In a Private Banking environment where data precision and availability are critical, you will play a key role within a scope covering accounting, business intelligence, planning and consolidation, and expense management. Your mission will be threefold:

• Ensure operational continuity through second and third-level support,

• Steer the evolution of the platform in close collaboration with the SAP product owner, and Finance stakeholders,

• Contribute to cross-functional project delivery.

You will also participate to our technological transition toward next-generation solutions (S/4HANA).

YOUR ROLE

Product Evolution & Project Delivery:

• Gather and analyze business requirements from Finance and Controlling teams.

• Design functional solutions and write specifications

• Contribute to BPC planning model evolution and BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud reporting developments

• S/4HANA Transformation: Actively contribute to S/4 Hana conversion projects and new onboarding projects.

• Manage end-to-end delivery of change requests and projects (scoping, testing, training, go-live).

• Configure SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) and CO modules.

• Ensure all changes comply with internal change management and audit frameworks.

Application support & maintenance:

• Provide Level 2 / Level 3 functional and technical support for SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC and Concur.

• Investigate, diagnose and resolve incidents within agreed SLAs; escalate to SAP when required.

• Monitor batch jobs, interfaces and data flows; ensure system health and data integrity.

• Manage transports, patches and corrections across the landscape.

• Maintain functional and technical documentation up to date after every change.

YOUR PROFILE

• Minimum 7 years of hands-on SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) experience in a complex, regulated environment (functional & technical expertise)

• Proven track record in both support/run activities and project mode

• Good command of SAP BW reporting, BPC planning & consolidation, and SAP Concur configuration and integration with SAP FI

• Knowledge or experience on S/4HANA architecture and migration concepts will be appreciated

• Solid understanding of financial accounting processes: general ledger, accounts payable/receivable, asset management, bank reconciliation

• Familiarity with private banking operational flows (client accounting, fees, treasury, regulatory reporting) is a plus

• Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate complex functional requirements into technical solutions

• Excellent communication skills – able to present to both technical and business audiences

• Rigorous, autonomous and structured; comfortable managing several tasks and priorities simultaneously

• Collaborative team player with a service-oriented attitude

• Full proficiency in French and English

• Residence

Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia.
