Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. SAP FI Application Expert (80-100%) All'interno del nostro reparto IT, si unirà a un team di esperti responsabili dell'evoluzione del nostro ecosistema finanziario. In un ambiente Private Banking dove la precisione e la disponibilità dei dati sono fondamentali, si svolgerà un ruolo chiave all'interno di un ambito di contabilità, business intelligence, pianificazione e consolidamento e gestione delle spese. La vostra missione sarà triplice:
• Assicurare la continuità operativa attraverso il supporto di secondo e terzo livello,
• Promuovere l'evoluzione della piattaforma in stretta collaborazione con il proprietario del prodotto SAP e con gli stakeholder Finance,
• Contribuire alla consegna del progetto interfunzionale. Parteciperai anche alla nostra transizione tecnologica verso soluzioni di nuova generazione (S/4HANA). Il tuo! Prodotto Evolution & Project Delivery:
• Raccogliere e analizzare i requisiti aziendali dai team Finance e Controlling.
• Progettazione di soluzioni funzionali e specifiche di scrittura
• Contribuire all'evoluzione del modello di pianificazione BPC e a BW/4, SAP Analytics Cloud
• S/4HANA Transformation: contribuisce attivamente ai progetti di conversione S/4 Hana e ai nuovi progetti di imbarco.
• Gestire la consegna end-to-end di richieste di cambiamento e progetti (scoping, test, formazione, go-live).
• Configurare i moduli SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) e CO.
• Assicurarsi che tutte le modifiche siano conformi ai quadri interni di gestione dei cambiamenti e audit. Supporto per applicazioni e manutenzione:
• Fornire il supporto tecnico e funzionale al livello 3 per SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC e Concur.
• Indagare, diagnosticare e risolvere gli incidenti all'interno di SLA concordati; escalare a SAP quando necessario.
• Monitorare lavori in batch, interfacce e flussi di dati; garantire la salute del sistema e l'integrità dei dati.
• Gestire trasporti, patch e correzioni attraverso il paesaggio.
• Mantenere documentazione funzionale e tecnica fino ad oggi dopo ogni cambiamento. Il tuo progetto
• Minimo 7 anni di esperienza SAP FI (80%) / CO (20%) in un ambiente complesso e regolamentato (esperienza funzionale e tecnica)
• Provato record di traccia in attività di supporto/esecuzione e modalità progetto
• Buon comando del reporting SAP BW, della pianificazione e del consolidamento BPC e della configurazione e integrazione SAP Concur con SAP FI
• La conoscenza o l'esperienza sui concetti di architettura e migrazione S/4HANA saranno apprezzati
• Comprensione solida dei processi contabili finanziari: registro generale, contabilità pagabile/ricevibile, gestione patrimoniale, riconciliazione bancaria
• La familiarità con i flussi operativi bancari privati (contabilità clienti, commissioni, tesoreria, reporting normativo) è un plus
• Forte mentalità analitica con capacità di tradurre complessi requisiti funzionali in soluzioni tecniche
• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione – in grado di presentare al pubblico sia tecnico che commerciale
• Rigoroso, autonomo e strutturato; gestione confortevole di più compiti e priorità contemporaneamente
• Giocatore di squadra collaborativo con un atteggiamento orientato al servizio
• Competenza completa in francese e inglese
• Residence

• Mitarbeiter mit einer serviceorientierten Einstellung
• Vollständige Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch und Englisch
• Ferienwohnung
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Une carrière chez Lombard Odier signifie travailler pour un gérant mondial de patrimoine et d'actifs renommé, avec un accent fort sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre entreprise indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de CHF 300 milliards et opérant depuis plus de 25 bureaux sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une maison d'investissement offrant une offre complète de gestion de portefeuille discrétionnaire et consultative, de services de patrimoine et de garde. Nous offrons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. Repensez Tout est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts grâce à plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Expert en applications SAP FI (80-100%) Au sein de notre département informatique, vous rejoindrez une équipe d'experts responsables de l'évolution de notre écosystème financier. Dans un environnement de banque privée où la précision et la disponibilité des données sont essentielles, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le domaine de la comptabilité, des renseignements commerciaux, de la planification et de la consolidation, et de la gestion des dépenses. Votre mission sera triple :
• Assurer la continuité opérationnelle grâce à l'appui des deuxième et troisième niveaux;
• suivre l'évolution de la plateforme en étroite collaboration avec le propriétaire du produit SAP et les parties prenantes financières,
• Contribuer à la réalisation de projets interfonctionnels. Vous participerez également à notre transition technologique vers des solutions de nouvelle génération (S/4HANA). Votre rôle Évolution du produit et livraison du projet :
• Recueillir et analyser les besoins opérationnels des équipes de finance et de contrôle.
• Concevoir des solutions fonctionnelles et des spécifications écrites
• Contribuer à l'évolution du modèle de planification de BPC et BW/4, développements de reporting SAP Analytics Cloud
• S/4HANA Transformation : contribuer activement aux projets de conversion S/4 Hana et aux nouveaux projets embarqués.
• Gérer l'exécution de bout en bout des demandes et des projets de changement (couverture, mise à l'essai, formation, mise en oeuvre).
• Configurer les modules SAP FI (GL, AR, AP, Asset Accounting) et CO.
• Veiller à ce que tous les changements soient conformes aux cadres internes de gestion du changement et d'audit. Support et entretien de l'application :
• Fournir un soutien fonctionnel et technique de niveau 2 / niveau 3 pour SAP FI/CO, BW/4 Hana, SAC, BPC et Concur.
• Enquêter, diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents dans le cadre des ALS convenus; passer au SAP au besoin.
• Surveiller les tâches, les interfaces et les flux de données par lots; assurer la santé et l'intégrité des données du système.
• Gérer les transports, les correctifs et les corrections à travers le paysage.
• Tenir à jour la documentation fonctionnelle et technique après chaque changement. VOTRE PROFIL
• Au moins 7 ans d'expérience pratique SAP FI (80 %) / CO (20 %) dans un environnement complexe et réglementé (expertise fonctionnelle et technique)
• Expérience éprouvée tant dans les activités de soutien/exécution que dans le mode projet
• Bonne maîtrise du reporting SAP BW, de la planification et de la consolidation BPC, et de la configuration et de l'intégration SAP Concur avec SAP FI
• Les connaissances ou l'expérience sur l'architecture et les concepts de migration S/4HANA seront appréciées
• Une bonne compréhension des processus de comptabilité financière : grand livre, comptes créditeurs/recettes, gestion des actifs, rapprochement des comptes bancaires
• Familiarisation avec les flux opérationnels des banques privées (comptabilité client, honoraires, trésorerie, rapports réglementaires) est un plus
• Un état d'esprit analytique fort capable de traduire des exigences fonctionnelles complexes en solutions techniques
• Excellentes compétences en communication – capables de présenter aux publics techniques et commerciaux
• Rigieuse, autonome et structurée; gestion confortable de plusieurs tâches et priorités simultanément
• Collaborateur avec une attitude axée sur le service
• Compréhension complète en français et en anglais
• Résidence

jobs.title: Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Integration and DevOps Engineer (80-100%)

Within the IT Operations unit, our team (16 people between Luxembourg and Geneva) is dedicated to integrate new business applications into our ecosystem according to the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure and Dev). Our team makes our core app evolution easier and smoother, without compromising quality.

YOUR ROLE

• Manage the release management process to reduce operational risk in prod and test environments:

• Coordinate planned changes between dev and production teams

• Facilitate the Change Advisory Board (CAB) meetings

• Efficiently integrate new business applications into the ecosystem from design to implementation in various environments (Dev/Test/UAT and prod)

• Coordinate and execute technical tasks based on the requirements of different stakeholders (Security/Platform/Production/Infrastructure/provider and Dev)

• Identify and mitigate risks, technical issues, and dependencies across the project

• Collaborate with the Provider (Third-party Package) on Lombard Odier technical requirements

• Develop the project's reference document in collaboration with Dev

• Estimate the workload of IT tasks during the project

• Implement continuous improvement using the Problem Management process to reduce downtime for business applications- Internal stakeholders: Development, Service Management (Incident/Problem Management), DBA, Network, Citrix/Virtualization, Tooling, IT Security, IT Risk.

• External stakeholders: Software and Service Vendors, Business Process Outsourcing Clients (Banks who are using our IT Platform and services)

YOUR PROFILE

• Master in IT or equivalent

• Good command of development languages and linked application servers: JAVA, JBOSS, C++

• Good command of CI/CD tooling: Openshift, Kubernetes, DevOps principles

• Good command of production tooling: FTP transferts, schedulers

• Previous experience of the Banking sector will be an asset

• Responsible, rigorous, versatile, with good interpersonal skills and team spirit. Ready to propose enhancements and participate to continuous improvment initiatives.

• Fluent in English and French

TECHNICAL ENVIRONMENT

• Service Now

• Serena

• ArgoCd

• NetScaler

• Java

• Apache/IIS

• Openshift

• Kubernetes

jobs.title: IT Security Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Security Engineer (80-100%)

The Security Engineer designs, implements and manages security solutions, ensuring an effective defense against cyber threats or data theft. Responsibilities include threat detection, vulnerability analysis, handling support tickets, and implementing security controls and related solutions (data leakage prevention, vulnerability management, security hardening, public key infrastructure, secrets management, privileged access management and endpoint security). The security engineer will also educate staff on best practices.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, implement, and maintain security solutions

• Conduct and/or contribute to security projects

• Assess and improve the security hardening of enterprise solutions

• Participate in alert and incident response reviews and propose improvement actions

• Propose new security solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop security workflows and automate recurring tasks

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, incident reports, security requirements

• Contribute to enforcing robust security tools and secure coding practices in development

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree computer engineering, security engineering or a relevant field. Master degree is an engineering school is a plus

• Sound experience of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and best practices

• Strong interest in IT security, continuous learning, secure engineering practices and threat modeling, IT market trends

• Strong knowledge of Azure cloud, Microsoft 365 services and hybrid cloud services

• Excellent command of automation, scripting, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) principles, common software architecture patterns, networking protocols and technologies

• Highly analytical and rigorous, with a solution‑oriented mindset and strong autonomy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

• Highly versatile and able to adapt to diverse technical contexts

• Fluency in English and French

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Una carriera a Lombard Odier significa lavorare per un rinomato asset manager globale, con un forte focus sugli investimenti sostenibili. Un'innovativa banca di scelta per clienti privati e istituzionali, il nostro Studio indipendente di proprietà è uno dei gruppi bancari più capitalizzati al mondo, che gestisce quasi 300 miliardi di franchi e opera da oltre 25 uffici in 4 continenti. Con una storia di oltre 230 anni, Lombard Odier è una casa di investimento che offre un'offerta completa di gestione del portafoglio discrezionale e consultivo, servizi di ricchezza e custodia. Offriamo anche servizi di asset management e strategie di investimento attraverso Lombard Odier Investment Manager e fornire tecnologia bancaria avanzata ad altre istituzioni finanziarie. “Rethink Everything” è la nostra filosofia – è al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo. Siamo cresciuti più forti attraverso più di 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo intorno a noi per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento per i nostri clienti. IT Security Engineer (80-100%) Il Security Engineer progetta, implementa e gestisce soluzioni di sicurezza, garantendo una difesa efficace contro le minacce informatiche o il furto di dati. Le responsabilità includono il rilevamento delle minacce, l'analisi delle vulnerabilità, la gestione dei biglietti di supporto, l'implementazione dei controlli di sicurezza e delle relative soluzioni (prevenzione delle perdite di dati, gestione delle vulnerabilità, indurimento della sicurezza, infrastruttura chiave pubblica, gestione dei segreti, gestione privilegiata dell'accesso e sicurezza endpoint). L'ingegnere della sicurezza educa anche il personale sulle migliori pratiche. Il tuo!
• Progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di soluzioni di sicurezza
• Condurre e/o contribuire a progetti di sicurezza
• Valutare e migliorare l'indurimento della sicurezza delle soluzioni aziendali
• Partecipare a recensioni di risposta all'avviso e agli incidenti e proporre azioni di miglioramento
• Proporre nuove soluzioni di sicurezza e contribuire a iniziative di miglioramento continuo
• Sviluppare flussi di lavoro di sicurezza e automatizzare le attività ricorrenti
• Mantenere la documentazione completa delle configurazioni del sistema, delle procedure, dei rapporti incidenti, dei requisiti di sicurezza
• Contribuire a rafforzare robusti strumenti di sicurezza e a garantire pratiche di codifica nello sviluppo Il tuo progetto
• Laurea di ingegneria informatica, ingegneria della sicurezza o un campo rilevante. Laurea magistrale è una scuola di ingegneria
• Esperienza sonora delle soluzioni e delle best practice di Data Loss Prevention (DLP)
• Forte interesse per la sicurezza informatica, l'apprendimento continuo, le pratiche ingegneristiche sicure e la modellazione delle minacce, le tendenze del mercato IT
• Forte conoscenza di cloud Azure, servizi Microsoft 365 e servizi cloud ibridi

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

IT Security Engineer (80-100%)

The Security Engineer designs, implements and manages security solutions, ensuring an effective defense against cyber threats or data theft. Responsibilities include threat detection, vulnerability analysis, handling support tickets, and implementing security controls and related solutions (data leakage prevention, vulnerability management, security hardening, public key infrastructure, secrets management, privileged access management and endpoint security). The security engineer will also educate staff on best practices.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, implement, and maintain security solutions

• Conduct and/or contribute to security projects

• Assess and improve the security hardening of enterprise solutions

• Participate in alert and incident response reviews and propose improvement actions

• Propose new security solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives

• Develop security workflows and automate recurring tasks

• Maintain comprehensive documentation of system configurations, procedures, incident reports, security requirements

• Contribute to enforcing robust security tools and secure coding practices in development

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree computer engineering, security engineering or a relevant field. Master degree is an engineering school is a plus

• Sound experience of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions and best practices

• Strong interest in IT security, continuous learning, secure engineering practices and threat modeling, IT market trends

• Strong knowledge of Azure cloud, Microsoft 365 services and hybrid cloud services

• Excellent command of automation, scripting, Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) principles, common software architecture patterns, networking protocols and technologies

• Highly analytical and rigorous, with a solution‑oriented mindset and strong autonomy

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate with both technical and non‑technical stakeholders

• Highly versatile and able to adapt to diverse technical contexts

• Fluency in English and French

• Residence in Switzerland or willingness to relocate

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Excellence drives us to be the best at what we do, while Innovation fuels our progress. Respect underpins every interaction, and Integrity shapes our actions. Together, we are One Team , united in serving our clients with unwavering dedication.

As a responsible and supportive employer, we promote a diverse and inclusive work environment for our employees and candidates. Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are woven into the fabric of our Maison’s DNA, and we strive to ensure that our employees can fulfill both their personal and professional aspirations by encouraging internal mobility and individual upskilling programs. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

Systems Engineer – Automation (Windows/VMware)

We are looking for a Windows Systems Engineer with a strong passion for automation and infrastructure optimization. You will join a dynamic team of 15 system engineering experts who manage a global infrastructure of more than 7,000 servers. This is a large-scale technical environment where expertise, innovation and advanced automation are at the core of our mission.
You will play a key role in the evolution and standardization of our IT landscape, with a strong focus on PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation, and Windows technologies such as Windows Server and Active Directory.
You will be involved in the design, implementation and maintenance of automation solutions aimed at improving operational efficiency and reducing manual intervention.
We actively encourage innovation and the proposal of new ideas to enhance our platforms.
We are currently driving several strategic initiatives, including the upgrade to VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) to modernize our virtualization stack, as well as a next generation observability project based on Elastic solutions.

YOUR ROLE

• Design, develop and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts to automate system administration tasks.

• Deploy, maintain, and optimize VMware Aria / vRealize Automation workflows and blueprints.

• Participate in the administration and evolution of Windows platforms, including Windows Server, Active Directory / ADFS / GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).

• Contribute to the adoption of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

• Ensure performance, security, and reliability across virtual and physical infrastructure.

• Collaborate closely with network, security, and development teams to integrate automation solutions across the organization.

• Support industrialization efforts, migrations, and continuous improvement projects.

YOUR PROFILE

• Excellent command of Windows Server administration.

• Excellent command of PowerShell (scripting, modules, APIs, end to end automation).

• Good command of VMware Aria / vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, blueprints, workflows). Knowledge of other Aria suite components is considered an asset.

• Knowledge of virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere).

• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD applied to automation, REST APIs, and system integrations

• Experience with Azure, Terraform, GIT and Ansible is considered an asset.

• Strong problem-solving mindset and continuous improvement orientation.

• Ability to work independently in a complex environment.

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills.

• Analytical approach and rigorous documentation practices.

Siamo diventati più forti attraverso oltre 40 crisi finanziarie ripensando il mondo che ci circonda per fornire una nuova prospettiva di investimento ai nostri clienti. Systems Engineer – Automazione (Windows/VMware) Cerchiamo un Systems Engineer Windows con una forte passione per l'automazione e l'ottimizzazione delle infrastrutture. Entrerai a far parte di un team dinamico di 15 esperti di ingegneria di sistema che gestiscono un'infrastruttura globale di oltre 7.000 server. Si tratta di un ambiente tecnico su larga scala in cui competenza, innovazione e automazione avanzata sono al centro della nostra missione. Avrai un ruolo chiave nell'evoluzione e nella standardizzazione del nostro panorama IT, con una forte attenzione a PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation e tecnologie Windows come Windows Server e Active Directory. Sarai coinvolto nella progettazione, implementazione e manutenzione di soluzioni di automazione volte a migliorare l'efficienza operativa e ridurre l'intervento manuale. Incoraggiamo attivamente l'innovazione e la proposta di nuove idee per migliorare le nostre piattaforme. Attualmente stiamo portando avanti diverse iniziative strategiche, tra cui l'aggiornamento a VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) per modernizzare il nostro stack di virtualizzazione, nonché un progetto di osservabilità di prossima generazione basato su soluzioni elastiche. IL TUO RUOLO
• Progetta, sviluppa e mantieni script avanzati di PowerShell per automatizzare le attività di amministrazione del sistema.
• Distribuisci, mantieni e ottimizza flussi di lavoro e blueprint di VMware Aria/vRealize Automation.
• Partecipare all'amministrazione e all'evoluzione delle piattaforme Windows, inclusi Windows Server, Active Directory/ADFS/GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).
• Contribuire all'adozione delle pratiche Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
• Garantire prestazioni, sicurezza e affidabilità nell'infrastruttura virtuale e fisica.
• Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di rete, sicurezza e sviluppo per integrare soluzioni di automazione in tutta l'organizzazione.
• Sostenere gli sforzi di industrializzazione, le migrazioni e i progetti di miglioramento continuo. IL TUO PROFILO
• Ottima padronanza dell'amministrazione di Windows Server.
• Ottima padronanza di PowerShell (scripting, moduli, API, automazione end-to-end).
• Buona padronanza di VMware Aria/vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, progetti, flussi di lavoro). La conoscenza degli altri componenti della suite Aria è considerata una risorsa.
• Conoscenza delle tecnologie di virtualizzazione (VMware vSphere).
• Conoscenza di Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD applicato all'automazione, API REST e integrazioni di sistema
• L'esperienza con Azure, Terraform, GIT e Ansible è considerata una risorsa.
• Forte mentalità di problem solving e orientamento al miglioramento continuo.
• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente in un ambiente complesso.
• Forte orientamento al servizio ed eccellenti capacità di comunicazione.
• Approccio analitico e pratiche di documentazione rigorose. NB: Si prega di notare che, in conformità con la normativa vigente e i requisiti del lavoro, al candidato selezionato verrà richiesto di fornire precedenti penali (sezione 3). descriptionByLocale.fr:
Faire carrière chez Lombard Odier, c'est travailler pour un gestionnaire de patrimoine et d'actifs de renommée mondiale, fortement axé sur l'investissement durable. Banque innovante de choix pour les clients privés et institutionnels, notre société indépendante est l'un des groupes bancaires les mieux capitalisés au monde, gérant près de 300 milliards de CHF et opérant à partir de plus de 25 bureaux répartis sur 4 continents. Avec une histoire de plus de 230 ans, Lombard Odier est une société d'investissement proposant une offre complète de gestion discrétionnaire et consultative de portefeuille, de services patrimoniaux et de conservation. Nous proposons également des services de gestion d'actifs et des stratégies d'investissement par l'intermédiaire de Lombard Odier Investment Managers et fournissons une technologie bancaire avancée à d'autres institutions financières. « Rethink Everything » est notre philosophie – elle est au cœur de tout ce que nous faisons. Nous sommes devenus plus forts à travers plus de 40 crises financières en repensant le monde qui nous entoure pour offrir une nouvelle perspective d'investissement à nos clients. Ingénieur systèmes – Automatisation (Windows/VMware) Nous recherchons un ingénieur systèmes Windows possédant une forte passion pour l'automatisation et l'optimisation des infrastructures. Vous rejoindrez une équipe dynamique de 15 experts en ingénierie système qui gèrent une infrastructure mondiale de plus de 7 000 serveurs. Il s’agit d’un environnement technique à grande échelle où l’expertise, l’innovation et l’automatisation avancée sont au cœur de notre mission. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'évolution et la standardisation de notre paysage informatique, en mettant l'accent sur PowerShell, VMware Aria/vRealize Automation et les technologies Windows telles que Windows Server et Active Directory. Vous serez impliqué dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et la maintenance de solutions d'automatisation visant à améliorer l'efficacité opérationnelle et à réduire les interventions manuelles. Nous encourageons activement l’innovation et la proposition de nouvelles idées pour enrichir nos plateformes. Nous menons actuellement plusieurs initiatives stratégiques, notamment la mise à niveau vers VMware Cloud Foundation 9 (VCF 9) pour moderniser notre pile de virtualisation, ainsi qu'un projet d'observabilité de nouvelle génération basé sur des solutions Elastic. VOTRE RÔLE
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des scripts PowerShell avancés pour automatiser les tâches d'administration système.
• Déployer, maintenir et optimiser les flux de travail et les plans VMware Aria / vRealize Automation.
• Participer à l'administration et à l'évolution des plateformes Windows, notamment Windows Server, Active Directory/ADFS/GPO, SCCM (Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager).
• Contribuer à l'adoption des pratiques Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
• Garantissez les performances, la sécurité et la fiabilité de l'infrastructure virtuelle et physique.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de réseau, de sécurité et de développement pour intégrer des solutions d'automatisation dans toute l'organisation.
• Accompagner les efforts d'industrialisation, les migrations et les projets d'amélioration continue. VOTRE PROFIL
• Excellente maîtrise de l'administration Windows Server.
• Excellente maîtrise de PowerShell (scripts, modules, API, automatisation de bout en bout).
• Bonne maîtrise de VMware Aria / vRealize Automation (vRA, vRO, blueprints, workflows). La connaissance des autres composants de la suite Aria est considérée comme un atout.
• Connaissance des technologies de virtualisation (VMware vSphere).
• Connaissance de l'Infrastructure as Code (IaC), du CI/CD appliqué à l'automatisation, des API REST et des intégrations de systèmes.
• Une expérience avec Azure, Terraform, GIT et Ansible est considérée comme un atout.
• Forte mentalité de résolution de problèmes et orientation vers l'amélioration continue.
• Capacité à travailler de manière autonome dans un environnement complexe.
• Forte orientation vers le service et excellentes compétences en communication.
• Approche analytique et pratiques de documentation rigoureuses. jobs.title: International IT Services Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
A career at Lombard Odier means working for a renowned global wealth and asset manager, with a strong focus on sustainable investing. An innovative bank of choice for private and institutional clients, our independently owned Firm is one of the best-capitalised banking groups in the world, managing close to CHF 300 billion and operating from over 25 offices across 4 continents.

With a history spanning over 230 years, Lombard Odier is an investment house providing a comprehensive offering of discretionary and advisory portfolio management, wealth services and custody. We also offer asset management services and investment strategies through Lombard Odier Investment Managers and provide advanced banking technology to other financial institutions.

“Rethink Everything” is our philosophy – it is at the heart of everything we do. We have grown stronger through more than 40 financial crises by rethinking the world around us to provide a fresh investment perspective for our clients.

International IT Services Specialist (80-100%)

International IT Services Specialists are responsible for the IT onsite support to Lombard Odier users across local offices. Their duties include installing, maintaining, and repairing hardware and software components of the organization’s computer systems. They provide support both remotely and through on-site visits, depending on the needs of the teams. The role involves frequent collaboration with Infrastructure Teams at the Headquarters, and depending on the context, may also take on project management responsibilities.

YOUR ROLE

• Provide support for Microsoft technologies: Windows 11, Office 365, Teams

• Manage Mobile Device Management for iOS and Android

• Assist in managing and maintaining network infrastructure under Level 3 supervision and perform 2nd-level troubleshooting

• Maintain and update the network and system CMDB (NetBox)

• Manage and maintain systems infrastructure in collaboration with the Systems Team (ESX)

• Manage and maintain the printing infrastructure

• Install and configure laptops, desktops, servers, switches, and perform patching work

• Troubleshoot and replace laptops, desktops, and components

• Support Citrix environments (XenApp, XenDesktop)

• Maintain and update software and hardware inventory

• Assist in budget preparation, manage contracts, and negotiate with local vendors

• Oversee contractor installations and maintenance during office moves, shutdown and opening operations

• Advise users on hardware and software usage

• Provide support to the bank’s Independent Asset Managers in the region

• Create, update, and maintain documentation and internal wiki

• Participate in implementation and deployment of group projects

• Contribute to the Business Continuity Plan and act as a point of contact during BCP invocation

YOUR PROFILE

• Degree in Computer Science, engineering or relevant field mandatory

• +7-years proven experience in IT technical support and similar roles

• Excellent command in installing, maintaining and troubleshooting computers running Windows 11

• Excellent command of Office 365, Teams

• Excellent command of Apple and Android mobile devices

• Strong knowledge of the OSI model and Enterprise Network Infrastructure

• Knowledge in Project Management of IT Infrastructure Projects

• Relevant certification from advantage (MS-700, CCNA, ITIL…)

• Willingness to continuously learn and high interest in new technologies

• High readiness to get things done

• Very good organization skills and ability to work independently and to be a great team player

• Strong service orientation and excellent communication skills

• Fluent in French and English

• Flexible to travel to the offices in the EMEA Region (Travel Activity 20%)

NB: Please be aware that in accordance with the current law and job requirements, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3).

Our Maison’s DNA is defined by five core values. Exc

• Struttura dell'account
• Sfondo professionale / personale del cliente
• SoW/SoF plausibilità e verifica

• Collaborare con il Front Office in modo tempestivo al fine di rispettare i requisiti normativi e politici, considerando gli obiettivi aziendali
